about: Mama Hen's three baby chicks are lost around the farm. Talk to a chick and it follows you; walk them into the coop to bring them home. The chicks themselves (names, where they hide, what they say) are in world/regions/farm.json (written by scripts/tools/map-authoring/farm_objects.py).
title: Help the Baby Chicks Find Mom

say: MY THREE BABY CHICKS WANDERED OFF, AND I CAN'T FIND THEM ANYWHERE!
PIP LOVES THE POND. NUTMEG LOVES PUMPKINS. AND ROSIE LOVES PINK FLOWERS.
WHEN YOU FIND ONE, SAY HELLO. IT WILL FOLLOW YOU HOME!

mama-hen: YOU FOUND {have} OF MY {need} CHICKS! KEEP LOOKING, {name}.
PIP LOVES THE POND. NUTMEG LOVES PUMPKINS. ROSIE LOVES THE PINK TREES OVER THE BRIDGE.
gardener: A LOST CHICK? I HEARD PEEPING BY MY PUMPKINS!
AND THERE'S A PEEPY LITTLE ONE NEAR THE POND, TOO.

steps.objective: Take the chicks home to Mama Hen

gardener: WHAT A PARADE! MAMA HEN IS IN THE COOP, JUST WEST OF THE HOUSE.

complete.speaker: mama-hen
say: MY BABIES! PIP, NUTMEG AND ROSIE, ALL SAFE AND SOUND!
THANK YOU, {name}. YOU ARE THE KINDEST FRIEND ON THE FARM.
HERE IS A LITTLE PRESENT FOR YOU. CLUCK!
